blog_title: Starting a T-Shirt Business in India at 21 — 9 Years of Wholesale Lessons From Delhi
caption:
Quit my CS job at 21. Built a ₹0 t-shirt business from my Delhi room. 9 years later, still printing.

No perfect pitch. No investor deck. Just 20 GSMs we actually liked, slim margins, and this one rule:

'Do it. Stop thinking. Things will never be perfect.'

Worst case? You skip one meal.

Save this if you're sourcing blanks for your next order 👇
